description.value: Golden Samosa Bakery is a long-established South Asian bakery in Surrey with over 30 years of history, producing more than a million handcrafted samosas annually. Known for their award-winning samosas in multiple varieties — potato-peas, paneer, chicken, and beef — the bakery also serves pakoras, chana masala, and samosa meals. It is a popular stop for bulk orders and community events, with a loyal following across Metro Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Golden Samosa Bakery is a real, operating bakery in Surrey with a 30-year history producing samosas and related South Asian snacks. The website corroborates the OSM phone number and URL, and the address unit 411 at 8342 130 Street is consistent. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags; the site focuses entirely on food offerings and ordering.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bakery with a confirmed web presence and operating history. A useful food stop for touring cyclists passing through Surrey.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website mentions a second location on Nordel Way; the OSM record and this listing correspond to the 130 Street location only.

Hot food.detail: Website lists freshly made samosas, chana masala, pakoras, and samosa meal plates available daily at the 130 Street location
